source_caption_text:
Lil Durk’s federal murder-for-hire trial is officially underway — and things have gotten extremely serious. 🦅⚖️

Lil Durk is on trial in Los Angeles over allegations that he orchestrated a revenge killing targeting rival rapper Quando Rondo. Prosecutors allege that the 2022 shooting was connected to the killing of Durk’s close friend King Von in 2020. Quando Rondo survived the attack, but his cousin Saviay’a “Lul Pab” Robinson was killed. Durk has pleaded not guilty. 

The prosecution’s case has recently taken a major turn with testimony from OTF Vonnie, Durk’s former assistant and a cooperating witness. Vonnie testified that Durk instructed him to help organize an earlier attempted attack on Quando Rondo in Georgia in 2021, before the fatal Los Angeles shooting the following year. 

Vonnie also testified directly about the alleged 2022 plot, describing how cars, weapons and members of the crew were organized before the group followed Quando’s entourage to the gas station where Lul Pab was killed. Prosecutors are using his testimony to argue that the Los Angeles shooting was part of a larger retaliation campaign rather than an isolated incident. 

But the defense is attacking Vonnie’s credibility hard. Durk’s attorneys have emphasized that Vonnie previously pleaded guilty and is cooperating with prosecutors, while also pointing to his personal connection to King Von and possible motivations for wanting revenge. 

The prosecution has also introduced digital evidence, including messages and other material from Durk’s iCloud, and the judge has allowed prosecutors to use certain lyrics as evidence. 

If convicted on the federal murder-for-hire charge, Durk faces a mandatory life sentence. The trial is still ongoing, so none of the allegations against him have been proven beyond a reasonable doubt. 

This is arguably the biggest legal battle of Lil Durk’s entire career — and the testimony coming out of that courtroom is already sending shockwaves through hip-hop. 🦅⚖️🔥 #LilDurk #Viral #Explorepage #FreeDurk #QuandoRondo
